displayName: Lease expiry decision: Leased runs requeue under every policy; Running runs only under AtLeastOnce; cancelled runs and runs out of attempts never requeue
Deployment JSON: retryOnNodeLoss alone maps (true AtLeastOnce, false AtMostOnce), effectPolicy wins when both agree, a disagreement is flagged, and output carries both fields
Dropped worker TCP connections recover before lease expiry without duplicate execution
A transient full worker/control-plane outage heals before lease expiry without retry or loss
A worker partitioned after its run started: under AtLeastOnce the run is requeued and succeeds on another worker (Sqlite)
A worker partitioned after its run started: under AtMostOnce the run ends Failed with NodeLost and never runs again, even after the deployment is changed to AtLeastOnce mid-run (Sqlite)
A worker partitioned after its run started: under Journaled the run ends Failed with NodeLost, because the CLI has unknown effect coverage (Sqlite)

REST: new deployments default to AtMostOnce, retryOnNodeLoss-only input maps, conflicts are 400 EffectPolicyConflict, responses carry both fields, runs record the policy, and changes are audited (Sqlite)
Manifests: omitted means AtMostOnce, retryOnNodeLoss maps, a conflict fails with EffectPolicyConflict, and export writes effectPolicy and round-trips unchanged (Sqlite)
MCP management: new deployments default to AtMostOnce, retryOnNodeLoss-only input maps, and a conflict is rejected naming effectPolicy (Sqlite)
A delegated child run follows its own deployment's effect policy, not its parent's (Sqlite)
